title: Heedful Death and Divine Assumption
summary: Prophet Muhammad advised on good assumptions about Allah before death.
translation: A person should always think positively. Refrain from dwelling on negative thoughts, as this can lead to negative actions. When one thinks positively, they intend to do good deeds, which results in a virtuous and pure community. This is why a very important Hadith of our Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him) is shared, which was reportedly stated three days before his passing. Hazrat Jabir (may Allah be pleased with him) narrates that he heard the Prophet (peace be upon him) saying: "None of you should die except while assuming good about Allah." This Hadith is recorded in Sahih Muslim. The Prophet (peace be upon him) instructed that none should face death without harboring good thoughts about Allah. During difficult times, one must avoid negative assumptions about Allah. Having good assumptions about Allah was emphasized. The Hadith also suggests staying engaged in good deeds, as one does not know when death will come. If one dies performing good deeds, they will be resurrected in the same state on the Day of Judgment: 'Every servant will be resurrected upon what they died doing.' Hence, the Hadith includes both meanings that one is resurrected according to their intentions and the state they died in.
